charts.title: TOI-5388 b: orbits around TOI-5388
charts.description: The orbits of TOI-5388's planets in this map from above, to scale, with TOI-5388 b highlighted and the direction to Earth down. Each orbit is the one the app draws, from the published period, a/R*, eccentricity and argument of periastron; the star is a marker, not to scale.

metadata.orbitSource: Poultourtzidis et al. 2026 (2026A&A...707A.106P), via the NASA Exoplanet Archive ps table (pl_refname POULTOURTZIDIS_ET_AL_2026): P 2.5946748 d
